message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to defeat B0100 by closing through a descending left turn, firing as its ammunition count drops, then reversing right to maintain useful post-launch geometry while its missile converges closely on the climbing opponent.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to avoid the B0100-launched missile by sustaining a hard turn from northeast toward north while holding roughly level flight, given the missile’s matching course change at similar altitude and its persistent position behind and southwest of the aircraft."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to defeat B0100 by closing through a descending left turn, firing as its ammunition count drops, then reversing right to maintain useful post-launch geometry while its missile converges closely on the climbing opponent.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to avoid the B0100-launched missile by sustaining a hard turn from northeast toward north while holding roughly level flight, given the missile’s matching course change at similar altitude and its persistent position behind and southwest of the aircraft.
